description: This file defines the 'Mean' class with static methods for calculating various types of averages such as geometric mean, harmonic mean, and trimmed mean in the context of spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Mean
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate different types of averages such as geometric mean, harmonic mean, and trimmed mean for spreadsheet data.

methods.name: geometric
methods.description: Calculates the geometric mean of a set of positive values. Returns an error if data contains non-positive values.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Calculates the trimmed mean by excluding a specified percentage of the lowest and highest data points.
